description:
Activate Kilo using Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Resolve the Kilo ability from step 1.
Activate Kilo using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
